en.text:
Fires a single tracking projectile that detonates on impact and creates a burning pool of fire. 

Projectile deals <pve 1184 /> <pvp [?] /> impact damage and <pve 269 /> <pvp [?] /> explosive damage over 7 meters. This is reduced to 0% damage at the edge of the radius.

Lingering pool deals <pve 46 /> <pvp [8] /> damage every 0.25 seconds for 1.75 seconds.
